notes.title: Blueprints: The Ultimate Recipe for Creativity - Playtest
notes.notes: [h2][b]Chefs of the world — get ready.[/b]  [/h2][p]In Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together, we’ve taken one of the biggest leaps since the first game. This time, you’re not just following recipes… you’re writing them.  [/p][p]  [/p][p]In the first Cooking Simulator, recipes were pretty much “carved in stone.” Stray from the instructions and any deviation from the instructions was treated as a mistake. Not anymore. With our brand-new Blueprint system, we’re putting creativity right in your hands — giving you the freedom to edit, swap, build, and completely reinvent dishes however you like.  [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]What’s a Blueprint? [/b] [/h3][p]Think of it as your personal recipe lab.  [/p][p]You can start with one of our dishes and tweak it… or go full mad-genius chef and create something totally unique from scratch.  [/p][p]Every ingredient. Every process. Every step. Yours to control.  [/p][p] [/p][p]Want to replace onions with leeks? Easy.  [/p][p]Add cheese to a burger? Done.  [/p][p]Build a five-step gourmet masterpiece? Go for it.  [/p][p][/p][p]The Blueprint system gives you access to all the ingredients and processes available in the game. It allows you to edit existing recipes or add brand-new ones. While working on a recipe, you can also track in real time how its flavor profile changes. In fact, it’s a simulation of all the cooking mechanics in our game! This makes it one of the more complex systems to operate, which is why we put a lot of effort into making the interface as clear and visually appealing as possible.  [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/d6820c68a0ecfd0fb3a5b1906428d18951968578.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Paths to Perfection [/b] [/h3][p] Every recipe is made up of paths — groups of actions for a set of ingredients.  [/p][p]Some are simple, like a broth (one path, everything in the pot).  [/p][p]Others are multi-step marvels, like a burger with fried bacon and onion rings:  [/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Grill the patty  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Toast the bun  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fry the bacon  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bread and deep-fry the onion rings  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Prep the raw toppings  [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]You can merge paths (fry onions before adding them to soup) or split them (serve components separately). It’s cooking, your way.  [/p][p]All paths eventually lead to assembly — the stage where everything prepared in the Blueprint is combined on the plate into a single portion for the customer.  [/p][p]The Blueprint system supports that too.  [/p][p]Each path must have at least one ingredient. An ingredient can be cut into one of its available cutting types or seasoned with spices. You can also specify the number of portions of that ingredient.  [/p][p]Ingredients can be treated with thermal or mechanical processing. You can add multiple processes to a single path, and processes can be repeated multiple times. If you want an ingredient to remain raw, no processing step is required — but keep in mind that some ingredients are inedible without thermal processing! Mechanical processing is also possible, such as blending.  [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/b7e7bc2a044055543da50f27cadf856582c53a22.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Control the Flavour [/b] [/h3][p]While you experiment, the Inspector panel shows how your changes affect the flavor profile — from the five basic tastes (salty, sweet, sour, bitter, umami) to extra attributes like spicy and fatty.  [/p][p]The graph displays information depending on what you’re focused on:  [/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]A single ingredient at a given stage of the path.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The entire process step at a given stage of the path.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The whole dish.  [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Monitoring these elements will be useful when dealing with different customer groups visiting your restaurant (but that’s a topic for another article ;).  [/p][p]Most importantly, there’s more than one way to achieve the same effect.  [/p][p] [/p][p]Want sweetness without sugar? Try carrots.  [/p][p]Need more umami? Mushrooms might be your answer.  [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/e347e5061a1df6fd353ec39f1baf191be18e686a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Save, Share, and Expand [/b] [/h3][p]Name your creations, save them, and add them to your restaurant menu. Each recipe even gets a complexity rating, so there’s more incentive to serve a gourmet feast instead of, say… salted water.  [/p][p] [/p][p]And the best part?  [/p][p]We’re planning to expand the Blueprint system over time with new processes and ingredients in various packages — meaning your creativity will keep growing long after launch.  [/p][p] [/p][p]Bottom line: In Cooking Simulator 2, you’re not just cooking meals. You’re crafting your culinary legacy.  [/p][p][/p][p]Next round in couple weeks we will let you cook it however this time we need your feedback on the blueprint itself as it is an important part of the process. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Join our playtest on Discord[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/bigcheesestudio"]https://discord.gg/bigcheesestudio[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]So, chef — what will your first Blueprint be?[/b] [/h3]

notes.title: Cooking Simulator 2 Devlog #6 - Containers 🥗👨‍🍳👌
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/09c222f536e76fc3bdd0f67f8aaa20eea3914f9e.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi Chefs![/b]👨‍🍳

Let’s check some of the new handy features that will turn cooking in [b]Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together[/b] into something even more professional!

While creating the game [b]we focus on improving the gameplay, which is based on recreating lifelike cooking in a professional kitchen.
[/b]
In Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together your task will be to prepare various meals for the restaurant’s guests simultaneously![b] That’s why you will have Chef’s little helpers at your disposal in the game. One of them may seem small but how important – a stainless steel container!
[/b]
[h3][b]CONTAINERS[/b] 👌[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/854507a538b592c8bd0bd8079fd9d7c0479bf937.png[/img]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2455360/announcements/detail/3960420675283006588?snr=2___]You already know that we introduced some changes in the BIG KITCHEN.[/url] [b]First of all, you’ll have separate work stations for cutting and preparing products. This is also the place where you can transfer products into the containers. They’ll have different sizes and you’ll be able to mark them with colorful stickers![/b]

In the heart of the Big Kitchen we have designed [b]two islands [/b]– as you know, we’ll introduce [b]a coop mode in the game![/b] On each island there are two assembly stations. [b]It means that you will be able to prepare not only one dish but four different meals at the same time! [/b]Each assembly station has [b]a place for 8 containers[/b], which gives us as many as 32 containers max.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/959f8aea3f8fabc8baaf4aa3a35e62921c2d4b35.png[/img]
It’s important to add that at the end of the day if you have some ingredients left, [b]you can store them in the fridge in the containers.[/b] It’ll extend the freshness of products. And if you’d like to run this place as a professional Chef you can prepare the ingredients in larger quantities in advance in the morning or in the evening for the next day’s cooking! [b]How cool is that 😃 [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/8a236201ee982c128e42d116036431df9b813973.png[/img]
[b][i]We’ll be revealing more tasty details soon! If you want to stay up-to-date with news and announcements wishlist and follow Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together on Steam!🚀[/i][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455360/Cooking_Simulator_2_Better_Together/https://steamcommunity.com/games/2455360/announcements/detail/3960420675283006588?snr=2___

notes.title: Cooking Simulator 2 Devlog #4 - Big Kitchen 👨‍🍳🍽️🍲
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/d0614b91cb35aca09366ef4b0c441023ebf95681.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi Chefs![/b]👨‍🍳

For sure you’ve noticed that [b]our games are marked by extraordinary realism and attention to detail.[/b] In Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together we did our best to create the Big Kitchen space as close as possible to real kitchens, which are the heart of every restaurant. A space [b]where you’ll feel like a real Chef doing real Chef’s tasks.[/b] Learn how we did that! 💛

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/efdea79e53c4ab42937744c6435f3f7de3e7b5bc.jpg[/img]
We did tons of research, and the whole team explored the facilities that make up a full-fledged restaurant kitchen. Our aim was to design a kitchen that will be functional, ergonomic and comfortable for you to use with one twist – it was being developed for more players as[b] our upcoming game will have co-op mode.[/b] We also examined [b]how you, the players, used the kitchen in Cooking Simulator and made some reasonable changes![/b]🎮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/a3ef449e72f169451f352a43290cd4cc32b2966f.jpg[/img]
[b]So what can you expect in the Big Kitchen in Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together❔[/b]🤔

You already know that in the heart of the kitchen there are two large kitchen islands with stoves on one side and an assembly station on the other as well as some free space to put things away. [b]To make it easier for you to play in the coop mode we’ve also doubled the number of grills, ovens, deep fryers and sinks.[/b] Against the wall there are two separate places with worktops for chopping and preparing ingredients before taking them to the kitchen island for processing and assembly. And [b]containers will be of great help here! [/b]🍳

On each island there are two assembly stations. It means that [b]you will be able to prepare ingredients and make four different dishes at the same time![/b] You will be able to prepare ingredients at the beginning of each day in larger quantities and [b]keep them in the containers with stickers.[/b] [b]But watch out! This time ingredients will lose their freshness if you leave them out of the fridge overnight![/b]🌿

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/3b93c807adaa8841a9433c75604a6a1e9548f21f.jpg[/img]
There are also two refrigerators at your disposal. [b]You can use the first one in the kitchen to extend product freshness or prepare your ingredients already for the next day's cooking and plan yourself what you want to have on hand.[/b] [b]The second one is in the pantry where you will find meat, fish and pre-ordered shopping. We’ve designed quite a lot of space in the pantry as in Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together there will be a lot of ingredients![/b] 🧀

Therefore, one of your tasks will be [b]careful management of the available space.[/b] There is also one improvement we hope you’ll love – [b]you can take a lot of ingredients with you back to the kitchen using a tray that will pop up spontaneously!🥩
[/b] 
The whole process was very exciting and we hope that cooking in the Big Kitchen will be an utmost fun for you Chefs! [b]Let us know what you think![/b] 🔥

[i]We’ll be revealing more tasty details soon! If you want to stay up-to-date with [b]news and announcements wishlist and follow Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together[/b] on Steam![/i]🙏

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455360/Cooking_Simulator_2_Better_Together/

notes.title: Cooking Simulator 2 Devlog #3 - Creating recipes ✍️🔥🍳
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/505331fda240fc31b78086c9db667ccbc9b705de.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi Chefs!👨‍🍳[/b]

Do you know this feeling when you rub your hands together and say: “Ok, so now let’s try with this one!”? Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together will give you even [b]more opportunities for being creative and experimenting.[/b] After all, it's a Chef's task to surprise the guests with new dishes, meet their tastes and special requests. All to build the restaurant’s good reputation.🏆

And if you hope for more [b]freedom in creating recipes[/b] then YES! We know that you’ve been waiting for this one!
 
[b]Designing dishes is an integral part of the gameplay in our upcoming game.[/b] Imagine that you can swap ingredients in a dish and adjust a thermal or mechanical treatment. Imagine that you can manage a detailed preparation path for each dish and change any step you want to try out new things or create your favourite dishes. [b]Like real Chefs do.[/b] [i]Are you excited?[/i]🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/6962bc94e5ac848bd7ba235e1d3c87981030452d.png[/img]
To help you in [b]experimenting and keeping track with new discoveries[/b], we’ve developed a recipe creator that[b] we’ve called a blueprint system.[/b] It was designed by our team specifically for Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together. [i]How cool is that?[/i]😎

Let us explain what it actually means! While making progress in the game you will gain cooking experience and unlock recipes just like in Cooking Simulator. But this time you will also have [b]access to the recipe creator that will give you the possibility to design a detailed preparation path for each dish [/b]including the ingredients, thermal treatment like: cooking, frying, baking, roasting, grilling, boiling and mechanical treatment like: mixing, straining, blending, coating as well as seasoning, cutting and flipping.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/6b24795a957772209d36d26bb7acd8b9bd76b53c.png[/img]

Imagine this situation. You get the order of preparing let’s say – a burger. In the blueprint system you will have a basic recipe and you will be able to [b]prepare its variations starting from ingredients to serving.[/b] It means that for example you will be able to prepare meat or vegetarian feeling and use different kinds of vegetable slices and seasoning. If you decide that some stage needs improvement – you can do that by [b]adding, removing or replacing any step you want[/b].🍔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/a8dc7d8ae071eea89f5f5feb82539d8b0a064e97.png[/img]
Thanks to the recipe creator you can unleash your cooking creativity!💡

[b]We’ll be revealing more tasty details soon! If you want to stay up-to-date with news and announcements wishlist and follow Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together on Steam![/b]☕

notes.title: Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together Demo release at NEXT FEST! ❤️‍🔥
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/6d892b16255dbc06b611839d79ba77fae3b90d73.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi Chefs!👨‍🍳[/b]

We've got some news to share with you all!🔥

[b]Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together demo is available now during the Steam Next Fest 🍳🎮 Steam Next Fest is a multi-day celebration of upcoming games being held from October 9th to 16th, 2023. We’re a part of it and we’re showing a sneak peek of our new game! 👨‍🍳[/b]

We’ve been working on Cooking Simulator 2 for some time now and although the demo does not come with co-op mode yet, we’ve decided to show you some key features and mechanics that are in the core loop of the game. We have changed a lot compared to Cooking Simulator 1 and we are curious to know what you think about the new mechanics, especially a brand new feature - the blueprint system, which is a system for creating recipes! We know that you’ve been asking for this one! Remember that not all the features planned for the final version of the game are available in the demo and all the elements and mechanics you’ll see will be improved until the release of the full game itself.

[b]🕹️ So what you can expect in the demo 🕹️[/b]

[b]A new assembly station: [/b]
We want you to feel even more like in a realistic restaurant kitchen, that’s why we’ve designed a new assembly station where you’ll be able to put together dishes from previously prepared ingredients.

[b]A new cutting system: [/b]
New cutting system is here to help you choose the cutting techniques and cut ingredients into equal portions.

[b]Recipe creator: [/b]
We’ve developed a tool that works as an editor inside the game and it gives you the possibility of creating recipes and tweaking them according to the customer’s needs and orders.

[b]Upgraded thermal treatment: [/b]
Our new system handles heat transfer within the ingredient. This means the possibility of preparing medium rare steaks!

[b]Chef’s toolbelt: [/b]
Forgot where you put down a spatula? Now you carry necessary kitchen tools with you all the time.

Your feedback is invaluable to us, and it will help us fine-tune the game for the full release. We’ve prepared a small survey so don’t hesitate and let us know what you think about the new mechanics and features! There is also a channel “feedback & suggestions” on Discord & “demo” in discussions tab on the game’s SteamPage where you can leave your thoughts.   

[i]Here you’ll find the survey:[/i] https://forms.gle/xG18yNzQmzubx51S9

[b]Thank you all for your contribution!🙏

Stay tuned for more updates and remember to add the game to your wishlist![/b]❤️‍🔥

notes.title: Cooking Simulator 2 - New release date! 📅🖋️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44253486/359edaae79188955d8cd9b6ffee7632946b0de6b.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi Chefs!👨‍🍳[/b]

Today we would like to share with you a [b]Cooking Simulator 2[/b] production update, we have decided to move it to the[b] first half of 2024[/b]. 

We’ve decided to postpone the launch of the game [b]so it can make a bigger impact[/b]. We want to [b]deliver the best culinary experience[/b] possible which [b]you’ll be able to enjoy together[/b] with your friend. And we’re constantly working to make this happen. 

We’re working on [b]additional functionalities[/b], in particular those related to the [b]development of the co-op mode[/b] as well as [b]some new mechanics[/b], which are an[b] important element of the game[/b]. Also, after examining the possibilities offered by the [b]new version of the Unity engine[/b], we made a decision to adapt the entire project to the new engine, which requires some extra time. With those few additional months[b] you can expect an even more polished title[/b] upon the release.

Meanwhile, there will be a [b]demo available on Steam soon[/b]! We also[b] invite you[/b] to take part in the [b]playtest[/b] that is [b]coming this autumn[/b] – we look forward to your feedback on co-op functionality. 🎮

Have you ever thought about running your own restaurant? The start won’t be easy but the [b]practice makes perfect.[/b] From humble beginnings in a burger joint, rise up to become the chef of the best restaurant in the city. [b]Climb up the career[/b] ladder and [b]make your dreams[/b] come true!

If you feel like you [b]need some help[/b], [b]just call up your friends![/b] Cooking is way better when [b]doing it together[/b]. Later you can thank them with a delicious dinner in your apartment.
